usem.ci_lookup.mgmt_suffixes.description: USEM CI lookup rule 420 (Management Interface Match). Comma separated DNS label suffixes that mark the management controller of a server; the rule strips the suffix and matches the server by the remaining name.

usem.ci_lookup.mgmt_os_markers.description: USEM CI lookup rule 420 (Management Interface Match). Comma separated words that identify a management controller in the operating system text reported by the scanner; when one is present the last hyphen segment of the label is stripped whatever it is.

usem.ci_lookup.interface_domains.description: USEM CI lookup rule 430 (Network Interface Name Match). Comma separated DNS domain fragments under which network devices are scanned per interface; a label under such a domain is walked prefix by prefix against Network Gear.

usem.ci_lookup.interface_markers.description: USEM CI lookup rule 430 (Network Interface Name Match). Comma separated label segments (the word itself or the word followed by digits) that mark an interface or VLAN address of a network device.

usem.ci_lookup.vip_os_markers.description: USEM CI lookup rule 460 (Load Balancer Service Match). Comma separated words that identify a load balancer product in the operating system text reported by the scanner; such a host is matched to its Load Balancer Service CI.

usem.ci_lookup.vip_markers.description: USEM CI lookup rule 460 (Load Balancer Service Match). Comma separated label segments (the word itself, the word followed by digits, or a segment ending in the word) that mark a virtual IP; such a host is matched to its Load Balancer Service CI.
